newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES to sell stake in China unit to CEG.
newsitem.headline: BES to sell stake in China unit to CEG.

text.p: Portugal's Banco Espirito Santo (BES) group said it had signed an agreement to sell a stake of up to 48 percent in its Asian unit Banco Espirito Santo do Oriente (BESO) to China Everbright Group (CEG).
BES said the agreement was intended to foster greater cooperation between the state-owned CEG and BESO.
"The agreement is aimed at setting up joint initiatives in China, south east Asia, Latin America and Africa, both in the banking sector and in other fields," a BES statement said.
It said the accord would also allow Portuguese companies access to the Chinese market both directly and through joint ventures.
The statement gave no further details.
